SysDataModelXML.SQLScript:
WITH RecursiveNumbers AS ( SELECT 1 AS Num UNION ALL SELECT Num + 1 FROM RecursiveNumbers WHERE Num < 10000 -- 最大扩展到10000行 )
SELECT CASE WHEN '{1}'= 'true' THEN C.CPYNAM_0 + B.BPAADDLIG_0 + B.BPAADDLIG_1 + B.BPAADDLIG_2 ELSE N' ' END 公司名称地址 ,CASE WHEN '{1}'= 'true' THEN 'Zweirad Union e-Mobility GmbH & Produktion Co.KG' ELSE N' ' END 公司名称 ,CASE WHEN '{1}' = 'true' THEN 'Kyselhäuser Str.23' ELSE N' ' END 地址 ,CASE WHEN '{1}' = 'true' THEN '06526 Sangerhausen' ELSE N' ' END 邮编城镇 ,MFG.MFGNUM_0 工单号 ,MFG.ITMREF_0 产品编码 ,ITM.ITMDES1_0 产品名称 ,ITM.ITMDES2_0 产品型号 -- ,CAST(CAST(MFG.EXTQTY_0 AS REAL) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT('0000' + CAST(RN.Num AS VARCHAR(10)), 4) 计划数量 ,'10000' + '/' + RIGHT('0000' + CAST(RN.Num AS VARCHAR(10)), 4) 计划数量 ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), MFG.CREDAT_0, 23) 创建日期 -- ,MFG.MFGNUM_0 + '-'+ CAST(CAST(MFG.EXTQTY_0 AS REAL) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT('0000' + CAST(RN.Num AS VARCHAR(10)), 4) 二维码 ,MFG.MFGNUM_0 + ' '+ '10000' + RIGHT('000' + CAST(RN.Num AS VARCHAR(10)), 4) 二维码 ,RN.Num 流水号 ,ITM.YMDDES_0 FROM MFGITM MFG LEFT JOIN COMPANY C ON C.CPY_0 = 'DE01' LEFT JOIN BPADDRESS B ON B.BPAADD_0 = C.BPAADD_0 AND B.BPANUM_0 = C.CPY_0 INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON MFG.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0 INNER JOIN RecursiveNumbers RN ON RN.Num <= CAST(MFG.EXTQTY_0 AS INT) WHERE MFG.MFGNUM_0 = '{0}' AND ('{3}' = '' OR '{3}' IS NULL OR RN.Num = CAST('{3}' AS INT)) ORDER BY RN.Num OPTION (MAXRECURSION 10000)
